title: Admin & Setup
tagline: Everything a wholesaler configures once, then rarely touches again
closeTag: Set it up once. The rest of the app just runs on top of it.

scenes.headline: Every fish, catalogued
scenes.subline: Category, size grade, shelf life, storage type — one place, editable by admin.

scenes.headline: Add a new one in seconds
scenes.subline: Name and size up front; the rest defaults sensibly and stays optional.

scenes.headline: Ready to grow beyond one site
scenes.subline: Add a warehouse any time — its in-transit locations are created automatically.

scenes.headline: Every fisherman, one screen
scenes.subline: Phone, port, typical catch, reliability — the people stock actually comes from.

scenes.headline: Onboard a new one directly
scenes.subline: No more falling back to raw SQL to add a vendor the app didn't know about.

scenes.headline: Your whole team, one screen
scenes.subline: Role labels that describe the job, not the database column.

scenes.headline: Roles — and who can self-approve
scenes.subline: Only admin/co-admin can ever skip the review step on their own reversals.

scenes.headline: Every change, logged
scenes.subline: Who changed what, and when — nothing silently overwritten.

scenes.headline: Assign by hand, or let it balance the load
scenes.subline: Round-robin picks whoever's least busy — and reassigns automatically if a role ever changes.

scenes.headline: Move stock between warehouses
scenes.subline: Cross-warehouse only — moving stock within one site is a repack, not a transfer.

scenes.headline: Record a loss honestly
scenes.subline: Every kg written off is tracked, not quietly subtracted.
